listing.name: Black Lion Ships — Unique Lion's Guard Encounter
listing.summary: "Black Lion Ships" adds a mysterious, one-of-a-kind Sindrian Diktat fleet to the Askonia system — The Black Lion and its associated ships. Lurking near the fringe jump point with a formidable escort, this unique fleet fields secret weapons hidden even from the Supreme Executor's eyes.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a unique Sindrian Diktat fleet featuring a modified Executor variant and associated ships to the Askonia system.

description:
"Black Lion Ships" adds a mysterious, one-of-a-kind Sindrian Diktat fleet to the Askonia system — The Black Lion and its associated ships. Lurking near the fringe jump point with a formidable escort, this unique fleet fields secret weapons hidden even from the Supreme Executor's eyes.

Download Here

Ships:

Spoiler
The Black Lion (Unique Executor Variant)

Spoiler
Codex: Modified in absolute secrecy from the already ambitious Executor platform, this midnight-hued monolith represents a severe, unsanctioned divergence from the Supreme Executor's publicly available teaching upon military doctrine. A close inspection of the hull reveals a chillingly professional overhaul. Though outwardly visually extremely similar to the Executor, the notoriously hazardous internal wiring features are absent, and the entire ship has been wired to a highly experimental temporal core, the statistically significant spike in leukemia within its crew considered well-worth the additional tactical capabilities brought to bear upon those who fall out of the Lion's Favor.

An unholy mix of highly experimental and surely unsafe, bleeding edge technologies, The Black Lion prowls the twilight fringes of Askonia, but for what? And if this ship was dreamt upon beyond the dreams of the Supreme Executor, to whom does the Black Lion and its roaming pack answer to?

Changes

Special Modifications is no longer default
Energy Bolt Coherer removed as a built-in hullmod
Advanced Optics added as a built-in hullmod
High Energy Focus ship system changed to Temporal Shell

Eagle (BL)

Spoiler
Changes

Special Modifications is no longer default
Energy Bolt Coherer removed as a built-in hullmod
Advanced Optics added as a built-in hullmod
Maneuvering Jets ship system changed to Plasma Jets

Brawler (BL)

Spoiler
Changes

Special Modifications is no longer default
Automated Ships added as a built-in hullmod
Two Kinetic Blasters are now added as built-in weapons
Maneuvering Jets ship system changed to Phase Skimmer

But Why?

The Executor is my favorite flagship. But it drives, or drove, me nuts that it had this whole-ass built-in hullmod that was effectively useless on its best builds. Now the Gigacannon getting gigabuffed makes that not as true anymore, but I already made the sprite and everything, and it was just there...

What is the intended balance of the mod?

Vanilla+. Temporal shell might have some weird interactions that I didn't account for, but in practice I found the capital ship speed counteracted the speed buff that it normally which balances things out, a little. Hard fights in Vanilla should remain hard fights. That said, the intended balance of the non-Exector BL ships are also supposed to be significant buffs over their base models but I hope that's still relatively balanced since the LG Eagle is mediocre and the LG Brawler is straight a--.

The fleet includes modified Eagle and Brawler variants with altered hullmods and ship systems. These ships lurk near the fringe jump point in Askonia, offering a formidable encounter with secret weapons.
